form.configDescription: Answer about your business. The text the agent follows is built from your answers.
form.knowledgeDescription: One topic per item. Each item becomes a training for the agent.
form.multiHelp: Select as many as you like.

preview.issues: {count, plural, =1 {Review the form: 1 field has a problem.} other {Review the form: # fields have a problem.}}
preview.modeChange: The agent switches to {mode} mode; the text, the knowledge base and the actions stay the same.
preview.nothingChanges: Nothing changes in the agent with these answers.
preview.mediaRemoved: {count} website or video training(s) from advanced mode are also removed.

settingLabels.onLackKnowLedge: Message when it does not know

review.nothingToPoint: Nothing to point out in this field.
review.showMoreImprovements: {count, plural, =1 {show 1 more improvement suggestion} other {show # more improvement suggestions}}
review.attentionPoints: {count, plural, =1 {1 point of attention} other {# points of attention}}
review.panelIntro: The AI reads what you wrote and points out problems, contradictions and better wording. The function and knowledge base text is sent to Bitrix24 Vibecode.
review.expectationLabel: What do you expect from the agent?
review.expectationHelp: Describe real situations the agent should handle. The AI checks whether the knowledge base covers them and suggests the missing items.
review.expectationTooShort: Describe real situations, with at least {min} characters.
review.keyRequired: AI review needs a Vibecode key.
review.askAdmin: Ask a portal administrator to set up the key.
review.fillSomething: Fill in a text or knowledge base field to review.
review.failedNotCharged: {count, plural, =1 {1 field was not reviewed and was not charged.} other {# fields were not reviewed and were not charged.}}
review.retryFailed: {count, plural, =1 {Review only this one · {cost}} other {Review only these · {cost}}}
review.crossError: Could not check for contradictions right now.
review.gapsError: Knowledge base coverage could not be checked right now.
review.gapPlaceholders: The [preencher: …] snippets depend on data from your business: complete them before publishing. Check each added item: the AI does not know your company.
review.covered: What the knowledge base already covers
review.impactBlocking: {count, plural, =1 {1 item hinders the agent} other {# items hinder the agent}}
review.impactPolish: {count, plural, =1 {1 has improvements} other {# have improvements}}

gapReasons.FULL: The field already has the maximum number of items.
gapReasons.LIMIT: The draft exceeds the character limit of the field.
gapReasons.REQUIRED: The draft is incomplete: a required subfield is missing.

review.failed: Could not review right now. Please try again.

assist.allFilled: All fields with help are already filled in
assist.intro: The AI writes a draft of the empty fields based on what you tell it. Nothing is saved until you apply it.
assist.aboutLabel: Tell us about the company and what the agent should do
assist.platformCredits: Generation uses CRMThink credits; the amount spent appears after generating.
assist.cost: {count, plural, =1 {This generation cost 1 credit.} other {This generation cost # credits.}}
assist.markers: {count, plural, =1 {1 snippet [preencher: …] to complete before publishing.} other {# snippets [preencher: …] to complete before publishing.}}
assist.skeleton: The AI did not have enough information: this text is just a skeleton. Complete the [preencher: …] snippets before publishing, because publishing is blocked while any remain.
assist.filledMeanwhile: The field was filled in meanwhile; I will not overwrite what is already there.
assist.notApplicable: This text exceeds the field limits and cannot be applied.
assist.failed: Could not generate right now. Please try again.

errors.AI_KEY_REQUIRED: To review with AI, enter the Vibecode key.
errors.AI_KEY_INVALID: Vibecode did not accept the key. Check that it was copied in full and is still active.
errors.AI_KEY_SCOPE: The key must have the vibe:ai scope.
errors.AI_NO_BALANCE: The Vibecode account ran out of balance or quota.
errors.AI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The key does not have access to the model used for the review, or it is offline.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: AI review is offline right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.AI_BUSY: Too many reviews right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.AI_FIELD_TOO_LARGE: This field is too large to be reviewed.
errors.NO_CREDIT: Your AI credits have run out. Add credits to continue.
